lines.beaver: 어서 와요. 앉아요. 저녁은 된장찌개하고 불고기예요.
lines.en: Wow, looks delicious. Thank you for the meal.
lines.beaver_en: Come on in. Have a seat. Dinner is doenjang stew and bulgogi.
lines.beaver_roman: Eoseo wayo. Anjayo. Jeonyeogeun doenjangjjigaehago bulgogiyeyo.

lines.en: It's a little bland. But it's tasty.
lines.beaver_en: You've tried the doenjang stew. How does it taste?

lines.learner: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 저는 싱거운 음식을 좋아해요.
lines.en: No, it's fine. I like mild food.
lines.roman: Aniyo, gwaenchanayo. Jeoneun singgeoun eumsigeul joahaeyo.
lines.beaver_en: Really? Then shall I add a little salt?

lines.beaver: 불고기도 먹어 봐요. 너무 달지 않아요?
lines.en: No, it's just right. It's really good.
lines.beaver_en: Try the bulgogi too. Isn't it too sweet?
lines.beaver_roman: Bulgogido meogeo bwayo. Neomu dalji anayo?

lines.learner: 김치가 너무 맵네요. 아직 매운 음식은 잘 못 먹어요.
lines.en: The kimchi is too spicy. I can't eat spicy food well yet.
lines.roman: Gimchiga neomu maemneyo. Ajik maeun eumsigeun jal mon meogeoyo.
lines.beaver_en: Why are you only eating a little kimchi?

lines.beaver: 아이고, 그럼 천천히 먹어요. 잡채도 있어요.
lines.learner: 잡채는 하나도 안 맵네요. 이거 정말 맛있어요.
lines.en: The japchae isn't spicy at all. This is really tasty.
lines.roman: Japchaeneun hanado an maemneyo. Igeo jeongmal masisseoyo.
lines.beaver_en: Oh my, then eat slowly. There's japchae too.
lines.beaver_roman: Aigo, geureom cheoncheonhi meogeoyo. Japchaedo isseoyo.

lines.learner: 네, 조금만 주세요. 배가 벌써 불러요.
lines.en: Yes, just a little please. I'm already full.
lines.roman: Ne, jogeumman juseyo. Baega beolsseo bulleoyo.
lines.beaver_en: Shall I give you some galbi too?

lines.learner: 와, 케이크가 아주 예쁘네요. 딸기도 달아요.
lines.en: Wow, the cake is so pretty. The strawberries are sweet too.
lines.roman: Wa, keikeuga aju yeppeuneyo. Ttalgido darayo.
lines.beaver_en: I prepared strawberries and cake for dessert.

lines.beaver: 마실 것도 줄까요? 우유하고 사이다가 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Shall I get you something to drink too? There's milk and soda.
lines.beaver_roman: Masil geotdo julkkayo? Uyuhago saidaga isseoyo.

lines.en: It was really delicious. Your cooking is the best.
Thank you. I enjoyed the meal.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you. I'll cook something tasty again tomorrow.
